verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch's semantic_text field automatically generates embeddings via a configured ML model at index time with no need for developers to build their own embedding pipeline, and the docs explicitly note no model-related settings or inference pipelines are required. It also supports managed/hosted embedding models or self-managed ones via the inference API, covering both built-in and managed embedder options. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the semantic_text auto-embedding workflow specifically (the runtime probes validate BM25 keyword search and MCP server, not the ML inference embedding path).
